read.thesis: Magna's Q2 margin gain of 70bps was driven mostly by operational excellence, not volume; FY26 EBIT margin guide raised to 6.3–6.6% and FCF to $1.75–1.85bn, though volumes are down and sales guide is roughly flat.

utilisation.quote: I think we usually manage that very closely. There's going to be some ups and downs.

triggers.label: Q2 margin +70bps, ops excellence ~75bps
triggers.quote: The largest benefit came from operational performance, volume and other, about 75 basis points.

triggers.label: Global LV production down ~2% (Magna-weighted)
triggers.quote: On a Magna-weighted basis for the full year, we think global light vehicle production will be down about 2%

triggers.label: 2H organic sales down ~1%
triggers.quote: the guidance at the midpoint would imply we're down kind of about 1% or so, a little bit over 1% organic

triggers.label: Q2 FCF $617M, more than double
triggers.quote: free cash flow was strong at $617 million, more than double last year's level.

guidance.quote: We've revised our full year sales outlook essentially to reflect our updated foreign currency assumptions
narrowed up our outlook for adjusted EBIT margin of between 6.3% and 6.6%, up 15 basis points at the midpoint
We have also narrowed and raised our outlook for adjusted EPS to between $6.70 and $7.30 per share.
we've increased our free cash flow outlook to $1.8 billion at the midpoint, up $100 million from our May outlook.

guidance.metric: Growth over market ex complete vehicles
guidance.quote: we continue to expect positive growth over market for 2026 in the range of 1% to 3%, excluding complete vehicles.
we plan to repurchase those shares in the second half.

prior_guidance_check.quote: Each of these metrics came in ahead of our expectations.
We took the full year guide at the midpoint up around $100 million

prior_guidance_check.metric: Growth over market 1-3% ex complete vehicles
prior_guidance_check.quote: we continue to expect positive growth over market for 2026 in the range of 1% to 3%, excluding complete vehicles.

red_flags.label: Tariff recovery timing flips negative in 2H
red_flags.quote: it'll probably flip a little negative on us because we had more recoveries last year that we got in the first half this year.

red_flags.label: Q2 tax benefit $0.09 reverses in 2H
red_flags.quote: we did have a $0.09 benefit in the quarter compared to the 23% guide. That will reverse in the second half

red_flags.label: Recovery-driven first-half cash flow
red_flags.quote: we had a big recovery we talked about on -- balance sheet recovery on the order of around $475 million.

evasions.quote: Mark, I would rather not talk about little programs at a time or programs piecemeal
a little bit too early to talk about next year, Jack.
we won't talk about the margin profiles by customer or into the future.
